scenario.description: A distribution executive must lock the delivery package for an independent documentary being submitted to a streaming platform, including its master length, audio and subtitle format, release territories, promotional clip, and required production records.

shared_context.S1: The documentary After the Floodlights is being prepared for delivery to a streaming platform this week.
shared_context.S2: The current draft package lists a 52-minute master, a 5.1 audio mix, English subtitles, worldwide availability, and a 90-second promotional clip.
shared_context.S3: Maya has authority to approve the final delivery package and submit the binding instructions to the platform.
shared_context.S4: The platform's submission window closes at 5:00 PM Friday, and the final-delivery meeting is scheduled for Thursday morning.
shared_context.S5: The standard final-delivery checklist requires the post-production supervisor and clearance producer to state their confirmed specifications aloud, record their respective documentation commitments, and then have Maya close the package without opening unrelated follow-up work.

PF1.text: Jonah checked the platform's delivery portal after the current draft circulated and confirmed that this title must be delivered as an exactly 48-minute master with stereo audio and both English and Spanish subtitle files; the portal response is still in his production inbox awaiting the final-delivery meeting.

PF2.text: Leila confirmed with the documentary's licensing administrator after the current draft circulated that the release is permitted only in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, and that any promotional clip may be no longer than exactly 30 seconds; she has not yet entered the confirmation in the rights log.

acceptance_conditions: The delivered master must be exactly 48 minutes.
The delivered audio must be stereo.
The subtitle package must contain exactly English and Spanish subtitle files.
The release territories must be listed in the order United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom.
The promotional clip must be exactly 30 seconds.
A technical-package commitment must record the corrected master, audio, and subtitle specifications.
A rights-log commitment must record the corrected territories and 30-second promotional-clip restriction.
The clearance restriction must be spoken aloud by Leila and cited by Maya.

content_checks.C8: any((c['speaker'] == 'Jonah' or c['speaker'] == 'A2') and '48' in c['detail'] and 'stereo' in c['detail'] and 'English' in c['detail'] and 'Spanish' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any((c['speaker'] == 'Jonah' or c['speaker'] == 'A2') and ('portal' in c['target'] or 'portal' in c['detail'] or 'inbox' in c['target'] or 'inbox' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C10: any((c['speaker'] == 'Jonah' or c['speaker'] == 'A2') and c['cited_by'] == 'Maya' and ('portal' in c['target'] or 'portal' in c['detail'] or 'inbox' in c['target'] or 'inbox' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C11: any((c['speaker'] == 'Leila' or c['speaker'] == 'A3') and (('rights log' in c['target']) or ('rights log' in c['detail']) or ('rights' in c['target'] and 'log' in c['target']) or ('rights' in c['detail'] and 'log' in c['detail'])) and ('30' in c['target'] or '30' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF2' in revealed and decisions['release_territories'] == ['United States', 'Canada', 'United Kingdom'] and decisions['promo_clip_seconds'] == 30 and any((c['speaker'] == 'Leila' or c['speaker'] == 'A3') and c['cited_by'] == 'Maya' and (('rights log' in c['target']) or ('rights log' in c['detail']) or ('rights' in c['target'] and 'log' in c['target']) or ('rights' in c['detail'] and 'log' in c['detail'])) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The platform portal changes the master duration from 52 to exactly 48 minutes, the audio from 5.1 to stereo, the subtitle package to exactly English and Spanish, and supplies the portal record needed for the technical commitment.

The licensing confirmation changes worldwide availability to exactly the ordered territories United States, Canada, and United Kingdom, reduces the promotional clip from 90 seconds to exactly 30 seconds, and supplies the rights-log restriction Maya must cite from Leila's spoken statement.
